died.name: Franz von Sickingen
died.cause: when his chaplain asked if he wanted to confess prior to his death defending his castle
died.last_words: I have already confessed my sins to God.

died.name: Andrew Fuller
died.desc: English Particular Baptist minister and theologian
died.last_words: I have no religious joys; but I have a hope, in the strength of which I think I could plunge into eternity.

died.name: Charles Frohman
died.cause: paraphrasing Peter Pan prior to dying in the sinking of the RMS Lusitania
died.last_words: Why fear death? Death is only a beautiful adventure.

died.name: Elbert Hubbard
died.cause: prior to dying with his wife in the sinking of the RMS Lusitania
died.last_words: Well, they [German Empire] have got us. They are a damn sight worse than I ever thought they were.

died.name: Alice Moore Hubbard
died.cause: on her husband being asked "What are you going to do?" prior to the sinking of the RMS Lusitania
died.last_words: There does not seem to be anything to do.

died.name: Albert Ball
died.desc: VC DSO2 MC, British World War I fighter ace
died.cause: said to a member of his ground crew before dying in a flying accident
died.last_words: I don't think so, I don't think so.

born.name: Józef Poniatowski
born.desc: Polish general and Marshal of the Empire
born.cause: While he was covering the French Army's retreat during the Battle of Leipzig, French forces prematurely blew up the only bridge over the White Elster before Poniatowski could reach it
born.last_words: Gentlemen, it behoves us now to die with honour.

born.name: Johannes Brahms
born.cause: after being given a glass of wine
born.last_words: Ah, that tastes nice. Thank you.

born.name: Owen Hart
born.cause: being interviewed on camera prior to fatal fall into ring at Over the Edge (1999) The 34-year-old Canadian professional wrestler fell to his death during the World Wrestling Federation's Over the Edge pay-per-view event. He was supposed to be lowered into the ring from the rafters as part of his Blue Blazer persona's entrance, but the equipment lowering him into the ring malfunctioned, causing him to fall 78 ft and land chest-first on the top rope. The impact severed his aorta, causing death within minutes.
born.last_words: Oooh, the Godfather, just saying his name makes my blue blood boil. OHHH! The Godfather, my arch nemesis, he represents everything that's wrong with the WWF. But fear not, because I, the Blue Blazer, will always triumph over evil doers, and you know why, because I always take my vitamins, say my prayers, and drink my milk, WHOOO!
